notes.title: Patch #6 - v1.1.8
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug that caused some of the settings to revert back to default (audio settings)
- Fixed some of the NPC dialogues not working properly
- Added a controller axis dead zone setting
- Added cheat codes
- Minor changes and fixes

notes.title: Patch #5 - v1.1.7

- Minor tweaks and fixes

notes.title: Patch #4 - v1.1.5 - Updated AI & Ubuntu 18 Support
notes.notes:
- Slightly increased AI reaction time
- AI accuracy increases/decreases depending on the distance of the player
- Fixed a bug related to AI line of sight
- Fixed a bug while opening a door and swinging an axe at the same time
- Improved performance
- Ubuntu 18 support
